question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beat.line: The risk is integration complexity — four distinct acquisitions absorbed across multiple geographies.
beat.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
beat.action: The coin stack scatters and four paper buildings land apart, each on its own patch.

sources: Diginex has now absorbed four distinct acquisitions (Plan A, Matter, The Remedy Project, Resulticks) across multiple geographies.
warnings: headline number "4" not found in cited sentences [10,11]
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the coin stack; four paper buildings.
Opens on the coin stack, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The coin stack scatters and four paper buildings land apart, each on its own patch.
Ends holding on the four buildings.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "4 ACQUISITIONS".

COPY LIST: "4 ACQUISITIONS". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: No voice, no speech, no dialogue, no lyrics. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects only; no music.
expandedPrompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a 2D-animated modern editorial paper collage with a refined motion design style. The scene is set against a solid, flat block-colour background of deep magenta with no gradients or glow. The lighting is consistent from the upper-left, casting small, subtle paper-layer shadows beneath every element. The frame opens with a central subject: a stack of black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of coins, featuring rough white torn-paper edges. Immediately on the first frame, the coin stack scatters outward with fast motion and a slight overshoot. As the coins disperse, four black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of buildings—each with rough white torn-paper edges—land firmly in separate areas of the frame, each resting on its own small, flat matte cream-colored paper patch. Simultaneously, a large, extra-bold black sans-serif headline "4 ACQUISITIONS" appears, printed on a clean cream-colored paper chip with a rough torn edge, positioned with safe margins. Every element is flat matte printed paper with visible print dots and a tactile paper texture; there are no luminous effects or 3D glossy surfaces. The camera remains a Static Shot throughout. By the end of the shot, the four buildings and the headline hold a stable reading window, with a very slight, subtle looping drift to maintain dynamism.

overall_soundscape: A series of crisp, rhythmic paper-slap sound effects as the coins scatter and the buildings land. These are accompanied by the tactile, sticky sounds of adhesive tape being pressed down. No voices or ambient noise.
